description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to Enlarge the time from 31.12.2018 up to 15.02.2019 for rendering of the final report on Commission of Inquiry that published Gaz. Ext. No. 2080/3 of 31.07.2018
reasoning: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Commission of Inquiry Act to extend the timeframe for a commission to investigate alleged irregularities in government-owned companies. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it deals with statutory powers, legal timeframes, and the operation of a commission established under specific legislation.
